failures.explanation: The July 28, 2025 update (D104) mentions travel expenses from "Dana's freight account" right after describing the Duluth trip for the Quarrendon QBR. Dana took over Quarrendon on June 2, 2025, and other notes use the same "Dana's freight account" label for it. This is an inference from context, since Dana also held Brackenwater until Sept 15, 2025, and that account is described elsewhere as "Marcus's LTL account" rather than Dana's freight account.

The July 28, 2025 weekly (D104) says Dana Okafor and Ilse were at the Quarrendon Freight Lines QBR with Thea Ramaswell, and later mentions travel expenses from "Dana's freight account". That ties the phrase to Quarrendon Freight Lines, which was Dana's account at that time.

The supplied records do not identify any account called "Dana's freight account". The only use of the phrase is in an undated North chat, which says no definitive customer identity is established. Dana's freight-named accounts are Quarrendon Freight Lines (since June 2, 2025) and Brackenwater Freight Co. (transferred to Marcus effective September 15, 2025), so the phrase cannot be tied to one of them.

The July 28 team update says Dana and Ilse attended the QBR and calls QFL her biggest customer. The wiki notes that "Dana's biggest" meant BWF in March 2025 but QFL after the June 2025 handoff. The wiki does not quote the exact phrase "Dana's freight account", so this mapping is inferred from the "biggest customer" wording.

The supplied Quarrendon amendments and renewal order preserve earlier agreement provisions but do not state a written non-renewal notice deadline. The underlying agreement containing any such deadline is not supplied.

The wiki cites the September 15, 2025 North weekly (D106) for BWF moving from Dana to Marcus effective that date, and for BWF's Door 6 appointment and trailer-field issues. I read "Dana's freight account" in that update as Brackenwater Freight Co., but the wiki does not quote the phrase itself. Dana also owned QFL on that date, so this is an inference.

The March pilot CRM labels CFO Pavel Ruud as decision maker with final sign-off, while the May 2 kickoff follow-up identifies COO Ines Barrow as the real operational decision maker, with the CFO only as budget approver. The wiki preserves both claims without saying which one supersedes the other, so no single decision maker can be established.
The July 28 update describes Dana’s visit to the Quarrendon Freight Lines QBR with Thea Ramaswell. The September 15 update explicitly identifies Quarrendon as Dana’s freight account.
The July 28 North weekly identifies Dana and Ilse as attending the QFL QBR and describes QFL as her biggest customer. QFL formally transferred to Dana effective June 2, 2025.

The July 28 update discusses Dana’s July 22 Quarrendon Freight Lines QBR before referring to travel expenses from “Dana's freight account.” The handoff email confirms Dana owned Quarrendon Freight Lines effective June 2, 2025.

None of the supplied Quarrendon documents (the amendments and the 2026 renewal order form) state a notice period for non-renewal. They only give seat counts, pricing, and effective and renewal dates, so the notice period is not recorded.
